name: qa-pr-review-agent
description: An AI QA engineer that reviews pull requests: reads the PR and its diff, analyses what it affects, writes or updates Playwright tests, runs them with the browser recorded, and comments the result on the pull request.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @qa-agent/shared && npm run build -w @qa-agent/backend && npm run build -w @qa-agent/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @qa-agent/backend" "npm run dev -w @qa-agent/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @qa-agent/shared && npm run typecheck -w @qa-agent/backend && npm run typecheck -w @qa-agent/frontend
